newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australia dlr soars, blue skies seen to 84 cts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australia dlr soars, blue skies seen to 84 cts.

text.p: Australian dollar bulls have a clear run toward a long term goal of 84 US cents after shattering six-year old highs Thursday.

Analysts and dealers were bullish beyond belief after the currency cleaved chart barriers at US$0.7970, US$0.7990/80 and US$0.8050 in a startling one cent surge. The technical euphoria was complemented by the scale and quality of the buying.
"The demand has been in serious amounts from decent names including people known for taking the long term view," said Steve North, forex sales manager at Chase Manhattan Australia.
